title: Sonam Wangchuk ends 26-day Delhi hunger strike, but exam-leak protest demands continue
summary: Wangchuk stopped fasting after negotiations and assurances of no legal action and parliamentary discussion, yet his resignation demand and the broader campaign — along with police crackdown measures — remain unresolved.
